# MCP tool contract fixtures

These are the unchanged `tools/list` responses produced by service revision
`4f1aee40916b808121e008edf67144fb8a4a5547` for MCP protocol versions
`2025-03-26` and `2025-06-18`. The JSON-RPC request ID is `definitions`.

The adapter tests verify that both contracts pass through HTTP-to-stdio
forwarding without rewriting names, descriptions, schemas or annotations.
The fixtures do not make the adapter a local implementation of the hosted tools.
